solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Spare pen, round container

indicators.note: round says the pen goes around the container

parts.note: a pigsty is a pen for pigs
a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: A writer asks for a spare pen and a round pot to keep it in.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare as an adjective means meagre or sparse, a synonym of scanty.

clue.text: Appropriate way up in department store

parts.note: a department store is a shop
a lift is a way up between floors

explanation.surface: The proper way up in a department store.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appropriate' is a verb, meaning to take, not the adjective 'suitable'.
explanation.definitionFit: To appropriate is to take for yourself, and shoplifting is stealing goods.

clue.text: Certainly not being passive as victim is abused

indicators.note: abused means mistreated, so the letters of as victim are knocked about

explanation.surface: Someone resists passivity because a victim is being abused.
explanation.definitionFit: Activism is campaigning action, the opposite of passive acceptance.

clue.text: See 12
Hand is extremely painful when involved in a break

indicators.note: involved in says the extreme letters sit inside the other pieces

parts.note: a pause is a break

indicators.note: extremely asks for the outermost letters of painful only

explanation.surface: An injured hand hurts terribly when it gets caught in a fracture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hand' means a round of clapping, not the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving someone a big hand means clapping them, so hand is an idiomatic synonym.

clue.text: One who's covered treatment of poorly child taking drug

indicators.note: taking means the rearranged letters hold the drug inside
treatment of signals reworking the letters of poorly child

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An insured parent's sick child is treated with medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment of' rearranges POORLY CHILD; 'taking' puts E inside, before the final R.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone holding an insurance policy is covered by it, so is insured.

clue.text: Cobbler tools part of shoe for a special function

parts.note: lasts are the foot-shaped forms a cobbler uses
the upper is the part of a shoe above the sole

explanation.surface: A shoemaker's tools and a shoe part, set out for a special occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Christ's final meal with the disciples was a uniquely special occasion or gathering.

clue.text: Owing a little money in international assistance

indicators.note: in says the penny goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: the UN, or United Nations, is the international body
aid is assistance
p, a penny, is a little money

explanation.surface: A small debt owed in global aid.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill still owing has not been settled, so it remains outstanding.

clue.text: One in three's poor as an alternative

indicators.note: in says the numeral goes inside the rearranged letters
poor means badly made, so the letters of three are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive 's adds no letters, leaving the word three as fodder
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: One in three people is poor, as another option.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' rearranges THREE to ETHER, and 'in' places I inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adverb it offers one choice or the other, so it introduces an option.

clue.text: Protest the conclusion of county court order

indicators.note: order, read as a verb, tells us to rearrange the word court
the conclusion of a word is its final letter, here of county

explanation.surface: Someone objects to the final ruling of a county court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' rearranges COURT into OUTCR; 'the conclusion of county' adds Y.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcry is a loud public protest against something.

clue.text: Joint for 18 in meat casserole

definitions.note: 18 across is carnal desire, so this is a den for lust

parts.note: flesh is meat
a pot is a casserole dish

explanation.surface: A cut of meat for lust, cooked into a stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 across is CARNAL DESIRE; a joint here is a place, not a cut of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleshpot is a venue for sensual indulgence, matching a place given over to lust.

clue.text: Temptation took place here in PM's backyard

definitions.meaning: in Genesis, Eve was tempted by the serpent in paradise
Sir Anthony Eden was a British Prime Minister, so his plot of land

explanation.surface: A political scandal brewing in the Prime Minister's own back garden.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Eden was UK Prime Minister 1955-57.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical paradise where Adam and Eve were tempted, and punningly a PM's yard.

clue.text: John "hot stuff" Major finally embraced in play

parts.note: lava is molten rock, literally hot stuff

indicators.note: embraced in says that letter is held inside the word for play

parts.note: to toy is to play

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of Major

explanation.surface: A nickname for former Prime Minister John Major, apparently embraced on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Major finally' is R, 'embraced in' TOY gives TORY. 'John' is slang for a toilet; John Major the Tory PM is misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: John is American slang for a toilet, the same room as a lavatory.

clue.text: County in real trouble needs money invested

indicators.note: invested means put inside, as money is put into a venture
trouble as a verb means stir up, so the words in real are rearranged

parts.note: cash is money

explanation.surface: A county in genuine difficulty needs some investment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges IN REAL and 'invested' puts the money inside. Lancashire is a county in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Lancashire is an English county, an example of the definition.

clue.text: Jazz and a cake for the tatterdemalion

parts.note: rag, short for ragtime, is an early jazz style
a muffin is a small cake

explanation.surface: Jazz and cake served up for a ragged fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A tatterdemalion is a person in ragged clothes, a scruffy urchin.

clue.text: Chef finally cooked spinach dish as traditional fare

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of Chef
cooked means messed about, so the letters of spinach dish are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chef makes a spinach dish as a traditional meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chef finally' is F; 'cooked' rearranges SPINACH DISH.
explanation.definitionFit: This battered seafood with fried potatoes is the classic British takeaway, a traditional meal.

clue.text: Barking mad pilot said "go to hell" and you look forward to the trip

definitions.text: said "go to hell" and you look forward to the trip
definitions.note: an old joke defines a tactful envoy as one who can tell you to go to hell so you relish the journey

indicators.note: barking means crazy, so the letters of mad pilot go wild

explanation.surface: An insane aviator who insults you so nicely you enjoy it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tactful envoy is so smooth that even an insult sounds like an invitation.

clue.text: Goliath, if he is drawn to light

parts.note: be he is the old subjunctive for if he is, as in be he rich or poor
a moth is drawn to light

explanation.surface: The setter Goliath, if he is lured to a lamp.
explanation.walkthrough: Goliath is also the setter's pseudonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Goliath the biblical giant stands for anything huge, a monster or giant beast.

clue.text: Worry about red nails stirring lust

indicators.note: about means the word for worry goes around the mixed letters

parts.note: care is worry, as in cares of the world

indicators.note: stirring means mixing up the letters of red nails

explanation.surface: Anxiety over scarlet nails that arouse desire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stirring' rearranges RED NAILS and 'about' wraps the worry around them.
explanation.definitionFit: Lust is strong sexual longing, a synonym of this phrase.

clue.text: With rough coverage from, say, BBC broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of say BBC are strewn

explanation.surface: Patchy news coverage from a broadcaster like the BBC.
explanation.definitionFit: A scabby surface is covered in crusty scabs, a rough coating.

clue.text: Brainboxes with firsts in cardiology, radiology & anatomy (not in astrophysics)

indicators.note: firsts in asks for the opening letter of each following word

explanation.surface: Clever students with first-class degrees in medical subjects but not astronomy.
explanation.walkthrough: '(not in astrophysics)' looks parenthetical but gives NIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Skulls, the plural of cranium, are literally boxes holding the brain.

clue.text: Mark half-circumvented contract

indicators.note: half asks for the first half of the word circumvented

parts.note: to flex a muscle is to contract it

explanation.surface: Someone called Mark half sidestepped an agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-circumvented' gives CIRCUM, the first six of twelve letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A circumflex is an accent mark written over a vowel, so it is a kind of mark.

clue.text: This artistic skill you acquire at the end

indicators.note: at the end asks for the final letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: An artistic skill that you only pick up late in life.
explanation.walkthrough: The last letters of 'artistic skill you acquire' spell the answer. 'This' refers to the clue itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue points to itself, a self-referential way of naming what a solver is reading.

clue.text: Bias from the foremost of show gardens

indicators.note: the foremost of picks the first letter of show

parts.note: Kew Gardens is the Royal Botanic Gardens in London

explanation.surface: Favouritism at a top garden show.
explanation.walkthrough: Kew is London's Royal Botanic Gardens.
explanation.definitionFit: To skew is to distort or slant, giving a bias.

clue.text: Indeed, if an objection is backed, it must be genuine

indicators.note: backed means sent backwards, so the run of letters is read in reverse
is stands in as the only signal that the answer sits within the preceding words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A lawyer insists that a supported objection must be sincere.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter gives no true hidden-word signal; 'is' is the nearest word to one. 'backed' turns EDIFANOB, found across 'Indeed, if an objection', around.
explanation.definitionFit: Bona fide is Latin for in good faith, meaning authentic or real.

clue.text: Stretched out, a thousand dance topless

parts.note: K is the usual abbreviation for a thousand, as in 10K

indicators.note: topless means losing the first letter of the dance

parts.note: the limbo is a dance under a low bar

explanation.surface: A thousand people dance without tops, arms stretched out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' drops the L from LIMBO.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms akimbo are bent out at the elbows with hands on hips, so stretched out sideways.

clue.text: Hunger means you start making money

indicators.note: start means the opening letter of you

parts.note: earning is making money

explanation.surface: Hunger means you have to start earning a living.
explanation.walkthrough: 'you start' gives Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunger in the sense of longing or craving is a synonym.

clue.text: Sticker sample

parts.note: the word splits as S plus ticker, and a ticker is slang for a watch

explanation.surface: A sample of an adhesive label.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Sticker' as S + TICKER; a ticker is a watch, giving S + WATCH.
explanation.definitionFit: A swatch is a small sample piece of fabric or material.
